what: The Color Palette Generator makes sets of colours that work together. Pick a rule, such as random, analogous, complementary, split complementary, triadic, square, monochrome, pastel or earthy, choose 3 to 8 colours and press Generate or the space bar.

Lock any colour to keep it while the others change, or pick a colour yourself with the pencil. Each swatch shows its HEX, RGB and HSL values, and tapping the code copies it. Copy the whole palette as CSS variables or a HEX list, download it as a picture, and save favourites on this device.
The Gradient tab builds linear, radial and conic CSS gradients with up to six colour stops. Start from a preset, a random gradient or your palette, then copy the CSS or save a 1920 × 1080 picture.
uses: Find colours that suit a logo or brand colour you already have.
Copy CSS variables straight into your stylesheet.
Pick a matching set of chart and heading colours.
Plan colours for painting, knitting or home decor.
Make gradient wallpapers and website backgrounds.
tutorial: Pick a rule in "Colour rule" and how many colours you want.
Type a HEX code such as #3b82f6 to build the palette around it.
Press Generate or the space bar to get new palettes.
Tap the lock on colours you like. Use the pencil to pick an exact colour.
Tap a code to copy it, or use Copy CSS, Copy HEX list, Download PNG or Save palette.
Press "Make a gradient" or open the Gradient tab. Change the type, angle and stops, then copy the CSS.
features: From random to complementary, triadic, monochrome and pastel.
Keep the ones you like while the rest change.
Every value shown and copied in one tap.
CSS variables, a HEX list or a palette picture.
Linear, radial or conic with up to six stops and presets.
Up to 40 kept on this device.

example.title: Worked example: a palette around a brand colour
example.text: A café owner types her logo colour #b45309 in "Start from colour", chooses Analogous and 5 colours, and presses Generate a few times. She locks a warm cream and a dark brown, generates again for the other two, then presses Copy CSS and sends the variables to her web designer.

tips: Use one strong colour for buttons and links and calmer ones for backgrounds.
Check text contrast: dark text on light colours and white text on dark ones.
Monochrome palettes are an easy way to look clean and professional.
Save palettes you like so you can compare them later.
In the Gradient tab, colours that sit close on the colour wheel blend most smoothly.
problems: Click on an empty part of the page first; it is ignored while you are typing in a box.
My colour code is not accepted
Use a HEX code with 3 or 6 digits, like #f80 or #ff8800.
Conic gradient will not save as a picture
Some older browsers cannot draw conic gradients. Choose Linear or Radial, or update your browser.
